threats.name: Prompt injection
threats.threat_agent: Remote unauthenticated attacker, malicious content author, compromised third-party tool
threats.impact: Data exfiltration, tool misuse, privilege escalation, malicious content generation
mitigations: Output filtering and human review for high-impact actions
threats.atlas_ref: Tactics: Initial Access, Execution, Collection, Exfiltration

threats.name: Agent tool poisoning
threats.threat_agent: Malicious external tool/data author; compromised integrations
threats.impact: Unintended agent actions, data leakage, supply-chain compromise of agent workflows
threats.atlas_ref: Tactics: ML Attack Staging, Defense Evasion, Impact

threats.name: Data poisoning
threats.threat_agent: Adversary with access to training supply chain
threats.impact: Backdoored or degraded model behavior, biased outputs, security bypasses
threats.atlas_ref: Tactic: ML Attack Staging - Training Data Poisoning

threats.name: Sensitive information disclosure
threats.threat_agent: User querying model; model training/retrieval error
threats.impact: Disclosure of personal or sensitive data, regulated data exposure, compliance breach

threats.name: Model and training data extraction
threats.impact: Theft of model weights/intellectual property, extraction of memorized training data

threats.name: Excessive agency and delegation abuse
threats.impact: Unintended privileged actions, lateral movement, resource misuse
mitigations: Limits on agent autonomy and scope
Human approval gates for high-impact actions

threats.name: Unsafe plugin / scaffolding interaction
threats.threat_agent: User controlling plugin input; compromised plugin
threats.impact: Arbitrary code execution, data access outside intended scope
mitigations: Strict input/output validation at plugin boundary
